---
title: "Installation Instructions"
---

Requires:
```bash
python >= 3.11
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Using uv (Super duper fast)
[Get uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/#pypi)

**Light (default)**

Headless graph only — Worker-safe. No Panel, LiteLLM, or OpenRouter.

```{.bash}
uv pip install pyllments
```

**Standard**

Laptop stock: light plus model SDKs, Panel recipes, and serve.

```{.bash}
uv pip install pyllments[standard]
```

**Full**

Standard plus local retrieval, embedding, and document processing
(e.g. PyTorch, lancedb, sentence-transformers).

```{.bash}
uv pip install pyllments[full]
```

## Using pip (Not super duper fast)

**Light (default)**

Headless graph only — Worker-safe. No Panel, LiteLLM, or OpenRouter.

```{.bash}
pip install pyllments
```

**Standard**

Laptop stock: light plus model SDKs, Panel recipes, and serve.

```{.bash}
pip install pyllments[standard]
```

**Full**

Standard plus local retrieval, embedding, and document processing
(e.g. PyTorch, lancedb, sentence-transformers).

```{.bash}
pip install pyllments[full]
```

:::
